en_title: The Pokémon Company Announces Facial Recognition System to Help Kill Scalping at Japanese Card Stores, Mandatory From Elementary School Age
cn_title: 日本宝可梦卡店启用强制人脸识别
subtitle: 从小学年龄起就要验脸

paragraphs.en: Pokémon card scalping has led to the introduction of a mandatory facial recognition system at some stores in Japan, for all adult customers and children at elementary school age or older.
paragraphs.cn: 宝可梦卡牌炒卖问题已促使日本部分门店引入强制人脸识别系统，适用于所有成年顾客以及小学年龄或以上的儿童。

paragraphs.en: The Pokémon Company announced the drastic measure in an update on its official Japanese website, which states that the move has been deemed necessary to provide "a safe and secure shopping environment for all customers" and "to prevent crime."
paragraphs.cn: 宝可梦公司在其日本官网的更新中公布了这项严厉措施，称这是为了提供「让所有顾客安心、安全购物的环境」并「防止犯罪」所必需的做法。

paragraphs.en: Entry to official Pokémon stores will be limited to one visit per person per day in order to limit customer spending, with repeat entry denied — though it's unclear exactly what else would happen if you did try and push your luck.
paragraphs.cn: 为限制顾客消费，宝可梦官方门店将限制每人每天只能进入一次，并拒绝重复入店——但如果有人试图碰碰运气，究竟还会发生什么尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: "To ensure compliance with our entry rules, if we observe multiple attempts to enter the store, our staff may speak to you individually," new guidanced has stated , which sounds like a polite way of saying you'll get a good scolding.
paragraphs.cn: 新指引写道：「为确保遵守入店规则，如我们发现多次尝试进入门店的行为，工作人员可能会单独与您沟通。」这听起来像是在委婉地说，你会被好好训一顿。

paragraphs.en: And while children under elementary school age (pre-schoolers) won't be subject to facial recognition checks, don't think you can just send in your young sibling/child to buy the cards for you. "Pre-schoolers cannot enter the store alone," the Pokémon Company noted. "They must be accompanied by a guardian."
paragraphs.cn: 虽然小学年龄以下的儿童（学龄前儿童）无需接受人脸识别检查，但别以为就能派年幼的弟弟妹妹或孩子替你买卡。宝可梦公司指出：「学龄前儿童不能独自进入门店，必须由监护人陪同。」

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa said The Pokémon Company would "take measures" to deal with the rampant shortages and scalping, though stopped short of mentioning anything specific. It seems likely Furukawa was referring to this facial recognition system — though whether it makes any dent on the lucrative Pokémon card resale market remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，任天堂社长古川俊太郎表示，宝可梦公司将「采取措施」应对普遍的缺货和炒卖，但没有提及具体内容。古川很可能指的就是这套人脸识别系统——不过它能否撼动利润丰厚的宝可梦卡牌转售市场，仍有待观察。

paragraphs.en: Pokémon cards have become a prime target for scalpers and thieves over the past few years due to their soaring popularity and the perceived value of rare cards. New card releases frequently sell out completely, and The Pokémon Company has appeared unable or unwilling to fully keep up with demand — despite a staggering 10 billion cards printed last year alone .
paragraphs.cn: 过去几年，宝可梦卡牌因人气飙升和稀有卡的潜在价值，成为炒卖者和盗贼的首要目标。新卡发售经常彻底售罄，而宝可梦公司似乎无力或不愿完全跟上需求——尽管仅去年就印制了惊人的100亿张卡牌。

paragraphs.en: Japanese promotions have sparked arguments in fast food chains, while in the U.S., barely a month goes by without a report of a trading card store being robbed and the past year alone has seen countless instances where trading card stores have been broken into overnight. Will facial recognition help? It seems something of a surprising step, but at this point it's unclear what else can be done to try and manage the situation.
paragraphs.cn: 日本的促销活动曾在快餐连锁店引发争吵；在美国，几乎每个月都有集换式卡牌店遭抢的报道，过去一年中更发生了无数起卡牌店夜间被闯入的事件。人脸识别会有帮助吗？这似乎是相当令人意外的一步，但事到如今，除它以外还能如何设法控制局面也并不清楚。

paragraphs.en: One card shop in New York was recently targeted by armed thieves in broad daylight, leaving terrified staff and shoppers held at gunpoint . In May, reports emerged of a Florida man who was arrested on suspicion of stealing $12,000 of Pokémon cards while wielding a battery-powered chainsaw . And in April, another desperate Pokémon fan was arrested in Pasadena, California, after .
paragraphs.cn: 纽约一家卡牌店最近在光天化日之下遭武装窃贼盯上，惊恐的员工和顾客被枪指着。5月有报道称，一名佛罗里达男子手持电动链锯，涉嫌盗走价值12,000美元(约合人民币8万元)(约合81240元人民币)的宝可梦卡牌而被捕。4月，加州帕萨迪纳又有另一名走投无路的宝可梦粉丝因[原文此处缺失内容]被捕。

summary: 为打击炒卖和犯罪，日本部分宝可梦官方卡牌店将对成年顾客及小学年龄以上儿童强制实行每日一次的人脸识别入店制度。宝可梦卡牌去年印制100亿张仍长期缺货，这项措施能否遏制转售市场尚待观察。
opus_summary: 宝可梦卡牌的炒卖与盗窃愈演愈烈，日本部分官方门店决定从小学年龄起强制人脸识别、每日限进一次。面对长期缺货与高额转售，效果仍待观察。
